Method of Attack: Exploitation of args4j command parser default behavior that expands file contents into command arguments when an argument starts with '@', allowing unauthorized reading of arbitrary files on Jenkins controller file system
Leads to admin privilege escalation and arbitrary remote code execution under certain conditions
Attack Vector: Unauthenticated attackers with 'overall/read' permission reading arbitrary files
Cross-site WebSocket hijacking by tricking user into clicking malicious link
Indicators of Compromise: Publicly available proof-of-concept exploits on GitHub
Jenkins honeypots detecting exploitation activity in the wild
